name: Trojan legends

attributes.attribute: claimed Trojan descent in Welsh and Irish tradition
Middle Irish tale of the wandering Ulysses
Irish text tracing descent from the Mediterranean

text: The Trojan legends connect the medieval Celts to the fall of Troy. Welsh tradition said Brutus the Trojan founded Britain. It claimed a Trojan ancestry for the Britons. The Irish Lebor Gabála Érenn traced the Gaels through a Mediterranean descent. Middle Irish writers made Troy their own subject. Togail Troí turns the destruction of Troy into Gaelic. The tale drew on Dares Phrygius. These works anchor the Celtic world to the classical past.

okr.objective: Record how Welsh and Irish tradition claimed a Trojan and classical descent.
